name: Elgi Equipments Ltd
title: Elgi Equipments Ltd - 522074 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Elgi FY26 sales up ~12% with volume only 3-4% and pricing thin; management plans a 2.5-3% price correction in June as ~80% of projected material cost inflation already hit in Q1, while capex is modest at ~200 crore.

capex.quote: we will probably have a normal you know, balancing CapEx of around 70 crores. So totally about 200 crores.

triggers.label: Price correction 2.5-3% planned June
triggers.quote: we looked at between 2 1/2 to 3% price correction, which has already been introduced in the market

triggers.label: Inventory reduction continues into FY27
triggers.quote: we will see continued improvement in our inventory levels into the next year in FY27

triggers.label: Commodity cost spike ~80% already hit
triggers.quote: close to 80% of our projected increase, has already happened in the first quarter

triggers.label: Chinese low-cost entrants churning bottom end
triggers.quote: The only segment where there is a bit of a churn is in the bottom segment where the Chinese players are making really low-cost machines

triggers.label: Conversion timing elongating
triggers.quote: Conversion timing is getting a little elongated, which for us is a bit of a caution in the market.

guidance.value: similar to last year, maybe a little better
guidance.quote: We will perform from a top line point of view very similarly as what we have done in terms of growth in the last year, maybe a little better.

guidance.value: roughly the same in percentage terms
guidance.quote: Bottom line will roughly be the same in terms of percentages.
more realistic case is a marginal profitability, yeah.

red_flags.label: Price correction contingent on commodity path
red_flags.quote: We are not sure about how long the metal commodity prices are going to continue.

red_flags.label: Forex gains unquantified
red_flags.quote: I don't have the number immediately in front of me

evasions.quote: I don't have the number immediately in front of me, but we could, if you can reach out to our finance organization

evasions.topic: FY27 margin path under commodity inflation
evasions.quote: We are not sure about how long the metal commodity prices are going to continue.
